pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/consolidate.rs:148 Consolidation selects the newest capped window and advances its checkpoint to the cycle time, leaving older overflow episodes outside subsequent windows.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/consolidate.rs:176 Comparison context is a fixed prefix of live facts ordered by scope and key, rather than a relevance shortlist redrawn for incoming evidence.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/store.rs:850 Automatic retirement checks importance and idle age without the required low-confidence gate or exemptions for protected kinds.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs:606 Store query or decoding failures propagate out of the turn instead of producing degraded recall with an unavailable-memory message.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs:917 Stream episodes close every configured number of ticks and contain joined turn records, rather than closing on meaningful outcomes with distilled bodies and raw-source pointers.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/store.rs:1405 verify_index compares markdown against metadata nodes and tombstones but never compares FTS membership, so a missing retrieval entry can escape the check.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs:647 Each recalled episode is silently clipped before window fitting; the later whole-episode omission notice does not disclose this loss.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/store.rs:775 Search orders by BM25 while retirement uses separate importance and idle-age rules, without a shared trust, decay and usefulness value model.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs:433 flush_turns timestamps accumulated earlier turns with the flush instant; their individual observation instants are absent from the consolidation evidence and its grounding contract.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/store.rs:428 A model-supplied supersedes reference resolves against the entire store without requiring membership in the facts the consolidation pass actually read.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/compose.rs:502 Recalled facts are shortened to 300 characters and rendered without their stored confidence or confirmation age, violating whole-item packing and standing labels.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/memory/store.rs:429 The supersede write checks only that its target is live, permitting a fact to retire an item from another scope or viewer.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/lib.rs:608 Conversation-history decoding silently skips malformed turns, and the subsequent eight-turn window supplies no omission or degradation notice to the model.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/directives.rs:118 Pending rules share directives.json with active rules and depend on reader filters; rejected proposals can also be proposed again, as the existing test explicitly expects.
